name: PRATAP NARAYAN CHOUBEY
summary: Backend-focused Software Engineer with production experience designing scalable APIs, authentication systems, and real-time data pipelines for a multi-tenant SaaS platform.

experience.whatdone: One of two engineers owning end-to-end backend development for a multi-tenant property/hostel management SaaS platform spanning Owner, Tenant, and Admin panels; Re-architected the backend data layer (Redis caching, MongoDB query optimization, duplicate API call elimination), cutting application load times from 20-30s to 3-4s (~85% reduction) and improving usability for property owners and tenants; Engineered an Aadhaar-based KYC verification pipeline with 15-second real-time polling, JWT-secured links, and approval-gating logic that blocks unverified listings from going live; Designed and shipped a two-signer e-signature workflow (Zoho Writer + Zoho Sign APIs) with sequential OAuth 2.0 callbacks and token rotation across dev/prod, reducing agreement turnaround from hours to under 5 minutes; Led authentication and access-control hardening (JWT, OAuth 2.0, role-based route guards) across all panels during a security audit, closing critical tenant-PII exposure and login-bypass vulnerabilities; Owned third-party integrations end-to-end, including Zoho CRM/Writer/Sign and Razorpay payment APIs with bank-account penny-drop verification.
